Problem Statement:
Prateek is unable to determine the minimum element from a list of numbers. Help him by writing a program that finds and prints the minimum element from the list. 
Input Description:
First line contains an integer n, the number of elements.
Second line contains n space-separated integers. 
Output Description:
Print the minimum element from the given list. 
Sample Input:
5
3 4 9 1 6 
Sample Output:
1
